howToPlay: Juju is an artillery brawler who gains unique buffs depending on the terrain she stands on. Use the Voodoo Chile gadget to unleash all elemental effects at once and summon the Gris-Gris to harass enemies with the Numbing Needles star power.
gears: Equip Damage to boost the impact of the earth-based attack buff, and Shield to improve survivability given the low health stat.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical positioning and adapting their combat style based on the environment.
